_meta.source: LIMEN Neural->Business Motif Crosswalk + Research Prospectus + Fractal-Weight Triage (2026-07-08/09)
_meta.purpose: The DEFENSIBLE layer: motif -> business FUNCTION + shared FAILURE MODES + isomorphism tier + fractal weight. Node->company is EMPIRICAL and NOT encoded here (expert's job).
_meta.rule: Grade a business mapping by whether the FAILURE MODE matches, not the surface sector. fractalWeight=true ONLY for M6/M8/M11 (shared human suboptimality). Everything else is T3 control-law universality (doctrine-neutral). Rating anti-correlates with fractal weight.

M1.name: Top-down inhibitory brake
M1.controlPrimitive: a slower contextual node suppresses a faster reactive unit (negative-sign top-down edge)
M1.businessFunction: risk/compliance slow-override of a reactive revenue desk (risk committee, legal hold) - the deliberative override, not the fast pre-trade limit
M1.failHyper: over-grip: the brake strangles the unit (wholesale de-risking, flatness)
M1.failHypo: brake-fail: the reactive unit runs unchecked (rogue desk, fraud)
cases: Archegos (brake overridden, ~$5.5B; Goldman/Morgan Stanley exited early = intact-brake contrast)
Boeing 737 MAX (safety brake weakened vs schedule)

M2.name: Gain / broadcast modulation
M2.controlPrimitive: one small node sets system-wide gain, one-to-many, multiplicative
M2.businessFunction: a single signal that rescales everyone at once (central-bank rate, firm-wide risk appetite / hurdle rate)
M2.failHyper: gain stuck high: hypervigilance, everything urgent, resources thrash
M2.failHypo: gain stuck low: signals missed, complacency before a break

M3.name: Homeostatic negative feedback
M3.controlPrimitive: output feeds back to shut off its own trigger, usually delayed
M3.businessFunction: self-correcting loops (inventory reorder, budget-to-actual variance, automatic stabilizers)
M3.fractalNote: cleanest match but WORST fractal bet - it is a pure control-theory theorem (Nyquist). Do not read a bullwhip/cortisol match as fractal proof.
cases: LTCM 1998 (mean-reversion assumed, runaway under Russia default)

M4.name: Gating relay (adjustable throughput)
M4.controlPrimitive: a hub passes or blocks signal based on system state
M4.businessFunction: throughput gates (capital-release/stage-gate, circuit breakers, procurement, a CFO releasing/holding spend)
M4.failHyper: gate stuck open: flooding, uncontrolled spend, no filtering
M4.failHypo: gate stuck closed: starvation, frozen capital, bottleneck
cases: 2010 Flash Crash -> single-stock circuit breakers (LULD) built afterward = gate that was absent

M5.name: Switching / resource reallocation
M5.controlPrimitive: an arbiter shifts control between mutually-exclusive competing modes
M5.businessFunction: capital/attention reallocation between BAU and crisis; explore/exploit arbiter above both
M5.failHyper: thrashing: switches too fast, no mode completes (strategy whiplash)
M5.failHypo: stuck in one mode: cannot switch to respond (rigid org misses a shift)
M5.fractalNote: secondary (T2 only if stuck/thrash occur at human, not market-optimal, parameters)
cases: Kodak (invented digital, could not reallocate off film)

M6.name: Feedforward prediction + error correction
M6.controlPrimitive: a model predicts; mismatch (error) updates the model - precision-weighting of prediction error
M6.businessFunction: forecasting + variance analysis with a directly readable learning rate (budget-vs-actual, demand forecasting)
M6.failHyper: priors too strong: ignores disconfirming data (confabulation, plans from belief)
M6.failHypo: no stable model: over-reacts to every fluctuation (noise-chasing, fragmentation)
M6.fractalNote: FRACTAL-BEARING: shared departure from Bayesian optimality; the learning rate is written in the config file (observable free parameter).
cases: Zara (holds capacity to respond to surprise)
Target Canada (planned from a bad model)

M7.name: Sustained vs phasic threat monitoring
M7.controlPrimitive: tonic (sustained, uncertain) vs phasic (acute, specific) alarm on one channel, two timescales
M7.businessFunction: continuous threat-intel/early-warning (tonic) vs incident response (phasic) off the same telemetry
M7.failHyper: tonic stuck on: chronic alarm, burnout, resource drain (permanent crisis footing)
M7.failHypo: phasic hair-trigger: overreaction to non-threats, false-alarm spam

M8.name: Anti-reward brake
M8.controlPrimitive: inhibitory suppression of the reward/pursuit channel itself, on a negative signal
M8.businessFunction: the brake on reward-seeking: stop-losses, drawdown limits, a strategy KILL-SWITCH, a committee that cuts a beloved-but-losing project
M8.failHyper: too strong: anhedonia, no risk appetite, nothing matures (learned-helplessness)
M8.failHypo: too weak: chases losses, sunk-cost escalation, cannot quit
M8.fractalNote: FRACTAL-BEARING: sunk-cost escalation is a costly HUMAN signature; = literally the KILLSWITCH structure; lateral habenula is a live depression/DBS target.
cases: JPMorgan London Whale 2012 (VaR brake breached then replaced with a lenient model; book -> ~$157B notional; ~$6.2B loss)

M9.name: Local E/I balance (unit self-regulation)
M9.controlPrimitive: local feedback inhibition keeps a unit stable - this is the E/I PARAMETER, not a node
M9.businessFunction: internal controls within a unit (a team's own QA, local budget discipline) - a PARAMETER on an edge, never a standalone firm
M9.failHyper: too much inhibition: over-control paralysis, process strangulation
M9.failHypo: too little inhibition: the unit destabilizes (seizure-like runaway)
M9.fractalNote: KNOWN-IMPOSSIBLE as a firm. Any model that promotes E/I to a node is mis-specified.

M10.name: Interoceptive aggregation -> salience
M10.controlPrimitive: afferent internal-state signals aggregate and get salience-weighted
M10.businessFunction: internal telemetry: KPI/ops-metric aggregation, firm-wide risk aggregation, deciding which internal signal to escalate
M10.failHyper: over-weighted: every internal fluctuation escalates (metric obsession, health-anxiety)
M10.failHypo: poor interoception: the firm cannot feel its own state (flying blind, organizational alexithymia)
cases: pre-2008 institutions that could not aggregate their own subprime exposure across desks

M11.name: Reward / motivation drive
M11.controlPrimitive: value-weighted drive channels resources toward expected return (incentive salience)
M11.businessFunction: incentive structures, compensation design, capital flowing toward expected return
M11.failHyper: drive too high: over-pursuit, bubbles (mania/addiction analog)
M11.fractalNote: FRACTAL-BEARING: wanting-vs-liking dissociation (incentive salience without hedonic value) is a costly human dissociation; comp structures are explicit dopaminergic-analog parameters.
cases: Wells Fargo (quotas+comp drove ~3.5M unauthorized accounts, ~5,300 dismissals, $185M fines = wanting decoupled from value)

M12.name: Rhythm generation / entrainment
M12.controlPrimitive: a pacemaker sets cadence; units entrain to it
M12.businessFunction: operational cadence (reporting/earnings cycles, sprint rhythm, market open/close)
M12.failHyper: over-rigid rhythm: cannot adapt timing to events (bureaucratic cadence)
M12.failHypo: desynchronization: units out of phase, coordination collapse
M12.fractalNote: weakest for a control primitive; cadence is closer to coordination than regulation. Quarterly cadence is not circadian.
